facts.fact: AfricaBrief reports Malawi is preparing its first Vital Statistics report, produced jointly by the National Statistical Office, the NRB and the Ministry of Health and expected in August 2024.

MWI.note: The national ID mop-up is mentioned only as preceding the birth campaign; no link between registers stated.
Nothing on a census or survey.

facts.fact: The NRB's Chief Registration Officer says 67% of births were registered in 2023, with death registration at 27%, a national rate not tied to a digital system.

MWI.note: Gives about 7 million under-16s without birth certificates, not a count or share enrolled in the national ID.
A birth registration campaign with no ID number at birth stated.
Nothing on who operates the ID system.
Nothing on registers using the ID number.
Mentions a national ID mop-up exercise only; no system detail.
No statement on digital entry at registration offices.
